title: Loop Control Payload Action
statement: For finite Boolean Turing machines $\mathrm{body}$ and $F$, any work-head movement $d$, optional emitted Boolean symbol, and optional next loop-host state, the loop-control action with no input-head movement and no actions on the flag and counter tapes, and with payload-head movement $d$ but no payload write, equals the right-block extension of the one-tape action that has no input-head movement, no write and movement $d$ on its sole work tape, and the specified output and next state.
